races.name: Daredevil Events Adrenaline Stunt Circus Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Luker's Tipple
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong hurdles form who benefits from the likely lack of pace pressure and has proven class edge over this field
runners_data.spotlight: Second in seven of his 12 races over hurdles, including when beaten 16l by subsequent Grade 1 winner Zeus Power at Thurles last December; had a Flat run last month; overdue for a win and looks the part here despite his concerning profile.

runners_data.name: Ballyminnion Boy
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with poor point-to-point completion record, making him unreliable despite his rating
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete his two point-to-point starts, not an obvious contender.

runners_data.name: Carry On Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up style hampered by poor completion record and 186 days off, needs everything to fall right
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on both starts in points last October; same outcome in a maiden hurdle at Cork.

runners_data.name: Tellyouwhat
runners_data.note: Debutant with tongue-tie fitted, breeding suggests ability but completely unproven over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Kingston Hill gelding, dam showed little but is a half-sister to several winners; fitted with tongue-tie for debut.

runners_data.name: Drumadeise
runners_data.note: Interesting pedigree connection to Getaway Katie Mai but trainer has limited recent success
runners_data.spotlight: Of some interest as a half-sister to Flat/bumper/hurdle winner Getaway Katie Mai; trainer did well with Master McShee some years ago.

runners_data.name: Lincoln Mill
runners_data.note: Recent point runner-up suggests some ability but may need further than this 2m trip
runners_data.spotlight: Clear of the third when runner-up in a maiden point at Dromahane recently; may need further; third reserve.

runners_data.name: Great Entirely
runners_data.note: Hold-up style hurt by poor recent form and the tactical disadvantage of sitting back in large field
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in a point; sixth of eight on hurdling debut at Wexford last month; considerable improvement needed.

runners_data.name: Million Dollar Man
runners_data.note: Showed promise on debut at 200-1, hold-up style but fair pedigree suggests potential improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on sole point run; has a fair pedigree and emerged with credit with sixth placing at 200-1 on recent hurdling debut at Clonmel.

runners_data.name: Game Point
runners_data.note: Prominent style ideally suited to this race shape, with solid hurdling debut form giving him clear experience edge
runners_data.spotlight: Useful but frustrating for Ger Lyons on the Flat, runner-up five times in a row in maidens, rated 77; fair third on hurdling debut at Sligo; good chance of reaching the money.

runners_data.name: Euro Agent
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from top yard but running out before last hurdle debut raises serious jumping concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Mild promise on second bumper outing for Eoin Griffin, none too fluent and ran out before last on hurdles debut at Leopardstown; remote fifth at Tramore last month on stable debut; does not seem straightforward; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Lureka Du Noyer
runners_data.note: Experienced French recruit whose hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage but has class to overcome weak opposition
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over fences in France; has plenty of experience; likely to make his presence felt in a race with little depth.

runners_data.name: Adifferentballowax
runners_data.note: Strong bumper debut form but tendency to fade late makes him vulnerable in competitive finish
runners_data.spotlight: From a good French jumping family; made his debut in a strong bumper at the Punchestown festival; second reserve.

runners_data.name: Inchidaly Rua
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with recent fair efforts but lacks the class to win, better suited to future handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Fair runs at Tramore and Cork; not a likely winner here, but could be one for handicaps in time.

runners_data.name: Lucky Vick
runners_data.note: Front running style perfectly suited as lone pace-setter, though amateur rider adds uncertainty factor
runners_data.spotlight: Fair effort at Thurles in his first bumper; not as good at Cork next time; best watched on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Seekthisfairland
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with extremely poor recent form, can be safely dismissed in weak heat
runners_data.spotlight: In rear in maiden hurdles at Wexford and Kilbeggan; safe to rule out.

runners_data.name: Another Blunder
runners_data.note: Prominent style negated by poor form and tendency to fade, well beaten in recent similar contest
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers last year; same on hurdling debut at Clonmel recently.

runners_data.name: Denham Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fading tendency, already well beaten by Game Point in direct form line
runners_data.spotlight: Well held by Game Point on running at Sligo recently; first reserve.

runners_data.name: Kidam Roque
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from long absence without hurdles experience, faces too many unknowns
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers; weak form on his last three Dundalk visits after hints of ability on his first two runs at that venue; no hurdling experience.

runners_data.name: King Maxios
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor recent form over longer trips, completely outclassed at this level
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in 2m4f maidens at Wexford and Killarney; in good hands but of no interest at this early stage of his career.

runners_data.name: God The Highness
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner rated significantly inferior to main rivals, beaten 60+ lengths on hurdles debut
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown some ability in low-grade staying handicaps on the Flat; rated 19lb inferior to Game Point; beaten in excess of 60l on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Blinding Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with appalling recent form, non-runner status makes him irrelevant to race analysis
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in three maiden hurdles last year; due to run at Ballinrobe on Tuesday.

races.paceDynamic: Lucky Vick is the sole confirmed front runner in this 21-runner maiden hurdle and will be allowed to dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Game Point and Luker's Tipple are likely to sit prominent, with the bulk of the field settling in midfield or worse given their inexperience. The lack of pace pressure will create a tactical affair where horses need to be positioned to strike from the home turn. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace, as they can track the moderate gallop and have first run on the large field of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Vick sets a steady pace and the prominent trackers get first run
scenarios.body: Game Point and Luker's Tipple can follow the leader's moderate gallop and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize. Their proven hurdles experience gives them a decisive advantage over the debutants and lightly-raced runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Vick's early lead translates into control throughout and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The combination of uncontested lead and amateur jockey confidence allows Lucky Vick to dictate completely and kick clear. His bumper form suggests he has the engine to sustain a gallop that burns off the inexperienced field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian enough for a patient ride to succeed
scenarios.body: Lureka Du Noyer's French experience and De Bromhead's training edge allows him to pick off tiring leaders despite the tactical disadvantage. The slow pace enables his hold-up style to be effective against the limited field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced horses underperform and a newcomer breaks through
scenarios.body: Million Dollar Man's 200-1 debut effort suggests untapped ability, and the weak overall standard opens the door. Ben Harvey's positive ride and the horse's fair pedigree could combine for a shock result.

watchPoints.text: Lucky Vick could steal this completely if allowed uncontested lead by amateur jockey who knows the horse well from trainer's yard
Game Point's Flat frustration with five runner-up efforts could translate to hurdles if he hits front too soon
Million Dollar Man's 200-1 debut sixth suggests trainer found improvement and could outrun odds again
Lureka Du Noyer needs the pace to collapse late to be effective from his hold-up position in this large field
Luker's Tipple has been second seven times over hurdles and needs to show killer instinct if getting first run

races.name: Great National South Court Hotel And Dial A Bus Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: La Cote Fleurie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven form advantage, De Bromhead stable in good order, handles good ground well
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off favourite when winning fair Tipperary bumper (2m, good to yielding) on debut in October; returned from seven-month break when beaten 1.75l into third of 15 on Cork hurdles debut (2m3f, good) 18 days ago; high on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Aruntothequeen
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner but previous handicap struggles raise questions about winning ability
runners_data.spotlight: Listed bumper winner at Gowran in 2024; decent efforts in maidens at 2m-2m4f; has been found wanting in handicaps, including valuable mares' race at the DRF; had a big ask at the weights when third to Switch From Diesel at Punchestown on latest (13lb worse than handicap terms); contender.

runners_data.name: Becca Sommers
runners_data.note: Unexposed newcomer from strong family, trainer in excellent form with small string
runners_data.spotlight: Maxios mare; half-sister to five winners inc Jaime Sommers (2m Flat, RPR 66; useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase), Pairc Na Ngael (2m4f-3m1f chase) and Halsafari (2m-2m4f hurdle/chase); dam very tough 1m6f-2m Flat and high-class bumper/2m-2m6f hurdle winner; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Humble Berkshire
runners_data.note: Debutante with solid pedigree but trainer struggling with recent runners
runners_data.spotlight: Berkshire mare; dam unraced half-sister to 1m6f Flat and smart 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Starchitect, out of 1m2f Listed winner; best watched.

runners_data.name: Pixie Hill
runners_data.note: Pulled up only start, impossible to assess but breeding suggests some ability
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 2m1f hurdle winner Getaway Henry; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Warrantor and Thebarrowman, out of bumper winner; pulled up sole point outing.

runners_data.name: Carleys Lilly
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed promise on debut, needs to improve significantly but upwardly mobile
runners_data.spotlight: Cheaply bought Blue Bresil mare but eyecatching debut effort when never-nearer fourth of 18 at Clonmel (16.5f, good to yielding) a fortnight ago, looking in need of this step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Doesthatmakesense
runners_data.note: Front-runner who fades late, was tailed off on debut but will likely set uncontested lead
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at odds of 33-1 when tailed off on bumper debut at Killarney this month; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Tawny Lea
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who faded badly on debut, breeding better than performance suggests
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to smart 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Duke Of Navan but always in rear on debut at Sligo 16 days ago.

runners_data.name: An Bhfuil Tu Reidh
runners_data.note: Fading hold-up horse with poor point-to-point form, tailed off rules debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in points; tailed off on rules debut at Killarney this month; safe to rule out.

runners_data.name: Ardeen Joy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 53-day break, showed some promise when third at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: First two runs at Kilbeggan and Ballinrobe offered little but outran 125-1 odds when remote third of 14 in 2m3f Cork mares' maiden last month; Sam Ewing takes over from claimer; likely improver.

runners_data.name: Eyecanboogie
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with modest form, tongue-tie discarded suggests trainer seeking improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Remote third in bumper for Willie Mullins; tailed off on stable debut; no impression on hurdling bow in tongue-tie (disgarded); needs to find major improvement but worth a market check nonetheless for local trainer.

runners_data.name: Knockarina
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 413 days off, solid bumper form but long absence concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Solid bumper form overall, particularly the runner-up finish to Familiar Dreams at Cork in January 2024; well beaten in two course bumpers a year apart; returns from 413-day absence; betting will provide clues on hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Chisel Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner soundly beaten by Aruntothequeen last time, significant form deficit
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten at Punchestown on debut; 52l behind Aruntothequeen when fourth at that track on latest; up against it.

runners_data.name: Certosa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistently poor form across bumpers and hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in four bumpers and maiden hurdle; best to look elsewhere on this occasion.

runners_data.name: Tillyiver
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades badly, completely tailed off behind La Cote Fleurie at Cork, now hooded
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form thus far and completely tailed off behind La Cote Fleurie at Cork on return; hooded.

runners_data.name: Jessie Roe
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making hurdles debut with poor bumper and point form
runners_data.spotlight: Five bumper efforts have amounted to little and a similar tale in her points; hurdles debut.

races.paceDynamic: Doesthatmakesense will lead uncontested with La Cote Fleurie and Aruntothequeen tracking in prominent positions early. With most runners holding up or settling midfield-back, the tempo will be sustainable rather than searching. The lack of genuine early pace will create a sprint finish where horses need to be positioned and travelling well turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who will face a wall of horses and limited room when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If La Cote Fleurie and Aruntothequeen track the leader smoothly and get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means these prominent runners avoid traffic problems and can utilise their class when the race develops. Their positioned advantage proves decisive in a bunched finish where hold-up horses struggle for room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers Becca Sommers or Humble Berkshire shows unexpected ability
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows an unexposed runner to travel kindly before producing a telling late effort. Their lack of exposed form becomes an advantage when the betting favourites disappoint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens earlier than expected and the field spreads out
scenarios.body: A staying-on type like Ardeen Joy or Knockarina benefits from increased galloping room and gets the strong pace they need. The extended trip and good ground suit their patient approach.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Doesthatmakesense Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains a strong gallop throughout and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows Doesthatmakesense to dictate terms completely and kick clear when challenged. Her stamina reserves prove superior despite her poor debut form suggesting otherwise.

watchPoints.text: La Cote Fleurie's market moves as she holds clear form advantage but returns from 18-day break
Doesthatmakesense for early pace-setting given her front-running style despite poor debut form
Becca Sommers and Humble Berkshire as unexposed newcomers who could surprise in weak maiden
Traffic problems developing in home straight given large field and limited early pace
Ardeen Joy's fitness returning from 53-day layoff under Sam Ewing booking

races.name: Irish Wire Products Ltd Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners_data.name: Run For The Border
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits this pace setup perfectly, 150 days off may have freshened him up after disappointing on testing ground
runners_data.spotlight: Probably not suited by testing ground in two runs before a break; won a maiden on good-to-yielding over 2m3f at this venue last October.

runners_data.name: Whitewinewednesday
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from powerful Mullins stable, 38 days since last run is ideal spacing for improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; a staying-on third at Navan last September (2m3f, yielding) was her best run for Matt Daly; failed to build on that on her last two starts before a break; down the field at Clonmel last month; an intriguing amateur-ridden Closutton runner now.

runners_data.name: Gaoithe Glory
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed promise when fourth here six weeks ago, trainer McNamara struggling for winners though
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a Listowel bumper (soft) in 2024 on debut; ordinary hurdles form overall; fourth over 2m here six weeks ago was reasonably promising after a break; one for the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Boston Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with hood fitted for first time, amateur rider's 7lb claim valuable in competitive handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Did not seem to handle the track at Bellewstown last; modest overall credentials; hood fitted now, may improve.

runners_data.name: Ranting And Raven
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner switching from Flat, recent Punchestown sixth suggests hurdling improvement possible
runners_data.spotlight: Blinkered when placed three times in middle-distance Flat handicaps on a sound surface for Johnny Murtagh; recent Punchestown sixth was best hurdles run so far and mildly encouraging.

runners_data.name: She'll Be Kept
runners_data.note: Prominent style could suit if she can avoid the traffic problems that often affect hold-up horses here
runners_data.spotlight: Remote second on her most recent point-to-point start; placed twice over hurdles last year, including in a claimer at this venue.

runners_data.name: Nashville Notions
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner and reserve, unconvincing handicap form makes him hard to fancy despite maiden win
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Sligo maiden over 2m2f last summer; unconvincing form in handicaps; reserve.

runners_data.name: Amburana
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been placed at Tramore, consistent without winning but holds each-way claims
runners_data.spotlight: Has made the frame twice at Tramore; beaten 20l in third on penultimate start; previous fourth was better, not beaten far in a race very well advertised by the winner Pebble Bleu and third-placed Cousin Kate; probably found 2m too sharp at Punchestown; each-way prospect.

runners_data.name: Thirsty Work
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but concerning tendency to fade in the finish, tongue-tie fitted suggests breathing issues
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; plenty of improvement needed from handicap debut at this venue.

runners_data.name: Wings Of Africa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade-in-finish warning, showed little in maidens last season
runners_data.spotlight: Showed nothing in three maidens last season; a little better at Clonmel after a break; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Winter Carnival
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 151 days off is a concern, 11-year-old now a 22-race maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Third at this venue in January 2025 seems to have been a flash in the pan; down the field here last December and absent since; now a 22-race maiden.

runners_data.name: Sekifi
runners_data.note: Prominent style but another with fade-in-finish warning, tongue-tie suggests ongoing issues
runners_data.spotlight: Has never reached the first three; however, might not be a lost cause judged on Bellewstown sixth, not beaten far on first run after a break.

runners_data.name: Larkins Lane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late, recent form mixed after promising Clonmel fifth
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth at Clonmel in March was slightly promising; two less satisfactory runs since then at Tramore and Cork.

runners_data.name: Let Him B
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won at Down Royal in spring, proven at this distance on similar ground
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive handicap hurdler in March/April; off the mark over 2m5f at Down Royal (yielding) and better again off 11lb higher when clear second to a ready winner over C&D (soft-to-heavy); every chance here if a poor recent chase run is ignored; reservations about good ground.

runners_data.name: Ixigreczed
runners_data.note: Front-runner with blinkers fitted, sole pace angle but concerning fade-in-finish pattern
runners_data.spotlight: Sole success came in 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap nearly two years ago; fair run in first-time blinkers at Clonmel in March; below that form last time at the same venue.

runners_data.name: Jollie Cosmos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 272 days off and 10 years old, point-to-point form doesn't always translate
runners_data.spotlight: Placed seven times in points; modest form on the track and getting on in years now.

runners_data.name: Ballinagaine Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but always at back in first handicap at Tramore, hard to fancy on that evidence
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little in maidens; always at the back at Tramore in her first handicap.

runners_data.name: Lake Okeechobee
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but weak maiden form, cheekpieces fitted suggest ongoing issues need addressing
runners_data.spotlight: Weak maiden form; last of 16 at Clonmel in her first handicap; cheekpieces tried now.

runners_data.name: Lost Features
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who was 50-1 and down the field at Wexford just 12 days ago in first handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; 50-1 when down the field at Wexford 12 days ago in her first handicap.

races.paceDynamic: Ixigreczed is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner field and will dictate terms from the flag with no early pressure. The large field will likely spread out behind him with prominent runners like She'll Be Kept, Amburana, Winter Carnival and Sekifi settling in the second group, while the majority of hold-up horses will be tracking from midfield and rear. Over 2m4f at Limerick, Ixigreczed can bowl along at a comfortable gallop without being harassed, setting up a tactical affair that builds from the back straight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick off a tiring leader and prominent runners in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed sets a moderate gallop and fades from two out...
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have been given the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Horses like Run For The Border and Let Him B can time their challenges to perfection when the early pace setters weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners travels smoothly and kicks before the hold-up horses can respond...
scenarios.body: She'll Be Kept or Amburana could steal a march by moving into contention at the third last and getting first run on the field. Their forward position allows them to capitalise if the hold-up horses are slow to get organised.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed finds more stamina than expected and the pace becomes truly testing...
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure could see him still travelling well turning for home, making it very difficult for the closers to peg him back. His front-running style would be perfectly suited to a scenario where he gets his own way throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed goes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home...
scenarios.body: A muddling pace would create a cavalry charge finish where the best horse on the day rather than tactical positioning determines the winner. This scrambled scenario could suit any runner with a turn of foot regardless of their usual style.

watchPoints.text: Ixigreczed could set a crawling pace as the only front-runner - watch for how fast he goes in the opening half-mile
Run For The Border returning after 150 days off - watch for early signs of fitness or ring rustiness
Several runners including Thirsty Work and Wings Of Africa have fade-in-finish warnings - watch their positions turning for home
Multiple horses have headgear changes including Boston Breeze's first-time hood - watch for immediate improvement
Let Him B carries top weight of 166lbs after spring success - watch how he travels under the burden in the early stages

races.name: Irish Wire Products Ltd Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners_data.name: Hidalgo Des Mottes
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned to track Not So Serious and strike first, though frustrating record suggests reliability concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Frustrating sort, placed in seven of his 21 starts over hurdles; risky and probably just a place chance at best; has had a run on the Flat since a well beaten fifth over hurdles at Kilbeggan last month.

runners_data.name: Qaasid
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer for in-form Hanlon yard, best hurdles effort when second at Clonmel, needs clean passage through large field
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner on the Flat in Britain; 0-11 hurdling for this yard, best effort yet when runner-up in a claimer at Clonmel in February; leading when slipped up going to three out at the same venue nine weeks ago; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Georginas Jet
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but failed to complete last time, 5lb claimer helps but needs to prove reliability
runners_data.spotlight: Could feature in this grade if recapturing the solid form she showed last August; however, plenty to prove on account of failures to complete on final start last year and on return last month.

runners_data.name: Evelyn
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner improving in maidens, good recent form suggests competitive in this grade
runners_data.spotlight: Has made the frame on her two most recent starts in maidens; likely to be competitive here if running to a similar level of form.

runners_data.name: Granlahan
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades late, longer trip may help but limited ability shown in maidens
runners_data.comment: Bit more promising at Cork last time; market worth a check on handicap debut; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Little sign of ability in maidens; has time on his side and this longer trip may help to produce improvement.

runners_data.name: Marian Avenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but fades late, excellent recent form when narrow second, 5lb penalty manageable
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten only a neck by odds-on chance Spanish Maid over 2m at Punchestown 15 days ago; 5l clear of the third then, 5lb extra may not stop him; good ground seems to have sparked his improvement.

runners_data.name: Getaway Henry
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 189-day break, best form over shorter but has won at course
runners_data.spotlight: Shock winner at Wexford in 2024; best effort last season when runner-up at Thurles in October; best form has been over shorter than this.

runners_data.name: Friar Hogan
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but fades in finish, early handicap career not promising despite in-form trainer
runners_data.spotlight: Still early days but his chance is not obvious based on his first two handicap attempts at Thurles and Sligo.

runners_data.name: Celtic Crossing
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, entitled to improve after comeback run following long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Was entitled to need her comeback run at Sligo after a long absence; one fair run when fifth at Roscommon in 2024; otherwise little of note in her form.

runners_data.name: Loulouless
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who fades late, mid-division last time at big odds suggests limited ability
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1 when finishing in mid-division at Clonmel two weeks ago; others much preferred.

runners_data.name: Hob's Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who finally broke maiden at 16th attempt, 6lb rise may prove testing for 10-year-old
runners_data.spotlight: 10yo mare; opened her hurdles account at Clonmel two weeks ago at the 16th attempt; 6lb higher, possibly vulnerable to younger rivals.

runners_data.name: Not So Serious
runners_data.note: Only front runner in field will dictate terms, weak recent form but tactical advantage significant
runners_data.spotlight: Weak maiden hurdle form; not a big price for two bumper starts last August when trained by Andy Slattery; reserve.

runners_data.name: Coup d'Essay
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades late, ratings appear generous based on maiden and handicap form
runners_data.spotlight: No impact in maidens; seems a bit high in the ratings on the evidence of handicap runs here and at Kilbeggan.

runners_data.name: Getaway Blondie
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, very weak historical form despite recent stable debut promise
runners_data.spotlight: Very weak form in previous years; prominent for a long way on stable debut at Bellewstown.

runners_data.name: Go Avel

races.paceDynamic: Not So Serious is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead over this extended 2m4f trip. With most runners showing hold-up tendencies and many carrying "fades in finish" warnings, the pace will be steady early before quickening from the home turn. The lack of early pace pressure means Not So Serious can set sustainable fractions, but the real action will come from the large pack of hold-up horses trying to time their runs in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike, as the wall of hold-up horses will create traffic problems and those getting first run will have a decisive advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious gets soft early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader sets ideal splits and has enough left to resist late challengers, while the pack of hold-up horses gets in each other's way. This extended trip suits front runners when they're not harassed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady but prominent types get ideal positions behind the leader
scenarios.body: Hidalgo Des Mottes and Marian Avenue can track Not So Serious and have first run on the turn, getting clear before the traffic-laden hold-up brigade can respond. The prominent style proves optimal in this tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the better hold-up horses gets a clean passage through the field
scenarios.body: A well-handicapped closer like Qaasid or improving sort like Evelyn threads through the pack to collar tiring leaders. The extended distance helps stamina-laden types who can sustain their finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get stuck in traffic or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The large field and tactical nature creates opportunities for unfancied runners with different profiles or those getting perfect runs. Complete pace collapse allows a rejuvenated veteran to strike.

races.paceDynamic: Marlpark is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the pace from the start, likely without serious pressure through the early stages. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (King Of The Greys, Another Glendaars, Cocovic, Takarengo, Committee Meeting, Chemdawg) with only Minella Diamond and Swelltime showing prominent tendencies. With such limited early pace, the gallop will be steady and controlled, setting up a cavalry charge from the back end. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays modest
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates perfect conditions for the strong contingent of hold-up horses to deliver their finishing kicks. Chemdawg and Cocovic, both in good recent form, can unleash their speed late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges Marlpark and the gallop becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. Minella Diamond's breakthrough win and Chemdawg's current momentum make them the primary beneficiaries of a weak pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horses apply pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Diamond and Swelltime take the race to Marlpark earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A more genuine gallop emerges that tests stamina over the 2m4f trip. Minella Diamond's recent breakthrough and proven stamina give him the edge in a more searching test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark gets his own way completely and maintains a decisive advantage
scenarios.body: The lack of quality pace-setters allows Marlpark to dictate completely and potentially steal the race. His proven ability to make all successfully at Clonmel gives him an outside chance if everything falls right.

races.paceDynamic: Navy Waves is listed as the confirmed front runner but appears to be a non-runner, leaving Sineads Fancy and John Dixen as the most prominent early runners in a field dominated by hold-up horses. With 11 of 14 remaining runners categorized as hold-up types, the early pace will likely be modest with Sineads Fancy potentially taking them along at a steady clip. The extended 2m6f trip and lack of genuine pace pressure will create a test of stamina rather than speed, with the real racing beginning from the second-last hurdle. This shape strongly favors patient hold-up horses with proven stamina who can produce late kicks, particularly those effective on good ground over extended distances.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Stayers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn-up creates a stamina test where horses with proven form over 2m4f+ can use their class late. Cozone and Western Model, both with strong staying credentials and course form, can outbattle less experienced stayers in a prolonged finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Sineads Fancy or another forward runner kicks from the second-last and steals a march
scenarios.body: The modest pace means any horse with tactical speed who can get first run will be hard to peg back up Limerick's testing hill. Sineads Fancy knows the trip well while Moonshine Girl could benefit from Jamie Townend's patient ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class From Low Weights
scenarios.trigger: If the handicap weights prove decisive in a slowly-run stamina test
scenarios.body: Horses carrying 150lbs or less get a significant advantage in testing conditions. Spellacy's Cross and Thats All can use their light burdens to outstay better-handicapped rivals who carry more weight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset From Improver
scenarios.trigger: If the extended trip brings out improvement from a lightly-raced type
scenarios.body: First-time headgear or return from a break could spark improvement. Laska Du Breuil or Jack Inthe Jukebox might find the longer trip suits better than their recent shorter efforts suggest.

races.paceDynamic: Je Suis will likely lead or share the lead with limited early pace pressure in this 14-runner handicap hurdle field. The prominent runners Poetic Focus, Rizedda, Craic Eile and Head For Home may track the pace, but the majority are hold-up horses who will need the race to come to them. With only one confirmed front-runner and most preferring to come from behind, this sets up a moderate gallop that could quicken from the second-last hurdle. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as the hold-up brigade may find insufficient pace collapse to make their usual finishing kicks effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis dictates at a manageable gallop without serious pressure until the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with plenty left for a finish, allowing prominent runners to kick when it matters rather than relying on pace collapse. Those tracking the leader can use their tactical position to full advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Get Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as prominent runners engage Je Suis earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased gallop sets up perfectly for the patient hold-up performers to unleash their finishing kicks. The large field of closers can exploit a genuine pace collapse in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Je Suis Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina reserves for a sustained finish up the hill
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front-runner to control the race completely and kick clear when challenged. Limerick's uphill finish rewards horses who travel strongly throughout rather than those depending on late acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis goes too fast early or prominent runners apply unexpected pressure in the opening mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with a crawling pace mid-race before a sprint finish develops. This totally random tempo could produce a surprise result from an unconsidered runner with natural pace.

watchPoints.text: Watch Je Suis early - if he goes too fast in the opening mile he'll set this up perfectly for the hold-up brigade
